champions.name: Kled
champions.tldr: Kled gameplay update: While out of combat, Skaarl will now tilt its head to look at nearby visible jungle monsters.; Resolved an error that sometimes caused players to have reduced performance when looking at Kled after he has re-mounted.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: While out of combat, Skaarl will now tilt its head to look at nearby visible jungle monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Resolved an error that sometimes caused players to have reduced performance when looking at Kled after he has re-mounted.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Remount health is now granted instantly upon beginning to remount, rather than after 0.5 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Kled now gains bonus armor and bonus magic resistance equal to 1% of bonus health, increased by 20% per nearby enemy champion within cr 1400 units, up to a maximum of 2% bonus health.

lines.label: Courage from minion kills
lines.note: Courage from minion kills increased to 5 from 4.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: Champion takedowns within 3 seconds of damaging them no longer grants 20 Courage.

lines.label: Dismounted attack damage penalty
lines.note: Dismounted attack damage penalty reduced to 15–0% from 20% at all levels.

lines.label: Dismounted movement speed penalty
lines.note: Dismounted movement speed penalty reduced to 40 from 60.

lines.note: Skaarl base health reduced to 400+(1000/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) from 400–1550. Now uses stat growth instead of linear growth.

lines.note: Remount health reduced to 40–70% (lv 1–16) of Skaarl's maximum health from 45–75% (lv 1–16)|health.

lines.note: New Effect: Granted bonus movement speed while dismounted now updates on level-up.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Additional instances of damage applied by a spell that causes the dismount are now properly ignored upon dismounting instead of unintentionally affecting Kled.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Dismount dash and its accompanying lockout are now exactly 0.5 seconds instead of lasting up to 0.25 seconds more based on engine ticks (they are no longer "fuzzy").

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Allied projectiles are no longer destroyed by the untargetability while dismounting.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Courage bar now always turns yellow when equal to or above 50 Courage instead of only when at 50–59 Courage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Kled's health no longer sometimes shows an incorrect amount after remounting.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Taking fatal damage while affected by Bailout (Renata Glasc)}} no longer breaks Kled's health bar for the rest of the game.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Skaarl's health is no longer unintentionally displayed while only Kled is affected by the protection of Bailout (Renata Glasc)}} after taking fatal damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Wild Growth (Lulu)}} no longer grants Kled more health than the intended health bonus based on Skaarl's base health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Health regeneration is now properly calculated upon remounting and no longer uses incorrect numbers for up to 0.25 seconds after remounting (it is no longer "fuzzy").

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: No longer unintentionally loses a minuscule amount of attack damage while dismounted.

lines.label: Tether bonus AD ratio
lines.note: Tether bonus AD ratio reduced to 60% bonus AD from 65%|AD.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: No longer applies Grievous Wounds for 5 seconds after successfully pulling the target.

lines.label: Slow
lines.note: Slow reduced to 30–50% from 40–60%.

lines.label: Slow duration
lines.note: Slow duration increased to 2.5 seconds from 1.5.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Damage calculations now update again for the pull instead of using the values at the time of the tether connecting.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now checks for enemy units within a from the projectile's origin point, prioritizing the closest unit that can be affected by the tether.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Pull timer is now exactly 1.75 seconds instead of lasting slightly longer.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Removed: Entering stasis during the first 0.25 seconds of remounting no longer postpones the remount sequence until stasis ends.

lines.label: Recharge timer

lines.label: Bonus AD ratio
lines.note: Bonus AD ratio reduced to 65% bonus AD from 80%|AD.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now checks for enemy champions within a from the projectiles' origin point.

lines.label: Change

lines.label: Cooldown

lines.label: Change

lines.label: Bonus AD ratio
lines.note: Bonus AD ratio reduced to 2% per 100 bonus AD from 5%|AD.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now scales with 0.4% per 100 bonus health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Attacking wards now maintains bonus attack speed rather than consuming the effect.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: While dismounted, the fourth attack is no longer invalidated by silence and forced action effects.

lines.label: Bonus AD ratio
